pages.text: After fighting you, this general has been won over by your strength, and he is willing to stand with you as an ally.

The Warlord has little use for spells - his strength is his craft - and even so his fighting power is formidable; as a black magician you are lucky to have such a champion.$(br)You can give the Wither Warlord $(item)Bones$() to heal him.
